title: Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2611.29884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. translated_title: 部分可观测性下强化学习的粒子信念表示
translated_abstract: 粒子滤波器能够灵活地表示复杂的多模态信念，但它们以加权的、无序集合的形式呈现，与传统的固定维度策略不兼容。我们在保持信念估计和策略优化不变的情况下，研究将粒子信念编码作为强化学习策略的输入。我们比较了统计摘要、累积量生成函数（CGF）特征以及置换不变的集合编码器。可训练的编码器既可以端到端学习，也可以通过信念重构或任务特定预测进行预训练。在八项任务中，基于池化的集合编码器和梯度CGF特征可以可靠地端到端训练，而Set Transformer在适当的预训练下取得了最高性能。当任务特定预训练的目标能够捕捉与决策相关的信念结构时，它会带来帮助，而重构预训练和潜在对齐则提供更具选择性的益处。对于选择和训练粒子信念编码器……
tldr: 该论文系统比较了统计摘要、CGF特征和置换不变集合编码器等多种粒子信念编码方法作为部分可观测强化学习策略输入的效果，发现池化集合编码器和梯度CGF特征适合端到端训练，而经过适当预训练的Set Transformer性能最佳，且预训练策略的选择取决于其目标能否捕捉与决策相关的信念结构。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares particle-belief encodings—statistical summaries, CGF features, and permutation-invariant set encoders—as policy inputs for RL under partial observability, finding that pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features work reliably end-to-end, a properly pretrained Set Transformer performs best, and the benefit of pretraining depends on whether its target captures decision-relevant belief structure.
